author: Marvel Entertainment
description:
This week, we take a look back at Marvel Studios’ first foray into animation with insights from Brad Winderbaum (Marvel Studios Head of Television, Streaming & Animation), A.C. Bradley (Executive Producer, Showrunner, and Head Writer), actor Jeffrey Wright, and more! Plus, we explore the history and origins of the series’ narrator, The Watcher, with a full comic book character breakdown.
